- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

# pr-1523: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)

## Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

The fold at `_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites only the in-memory `newMessages` / `currentContext.messages` and the `AgentEndEvent` payload. By the time it runs, two consumers have already seen the unstripped ledger:

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.

Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

🚨 **BLOCKING: the strip runs after the message was already persisted and rendered — the transcript still shows the ledger**

The fold at `_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites only the in-memory `newMessages` / `currentContext.messages` and the `AgentEndEvent` payload. By the time it runs, two consumers have already seen the unstripped ledger:

1. **Live render** — the CLI streams answer deltas via `_onTextDelta` (`approval_commands.dart:1292`) and prints the buffered answer in `_flushAssistantStreamAtEnd` on `MessageEndEvent`. The fold cannot un-print text that already reached stdout.
2. **Session persistence** — `_persistIncremental` (`agent_cli_persist.dart:12`) appends every `MessageEndEvent` message to the session JSONL immediately. The final assistant record on disk therefore still contains the full `task-ledger` block.

Verified empirically (scripted headless run, `read` tool call + fenced ledger answer): the persisted assistant record in the session JSONL still contains the complete unstripped ledger. Consequences:

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.
- `fa trajectory`, the attach view, and the bench `agent-logs/fah-sessions` sync all render the ledger from the JSONL assistant record.

This contradicts the PR description ("whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it") and ticket requirement 2 ("parse, persist as the hidden record, never leave it in the transcript"). The existing tests don't catch it because they assert only the `AgentEndEvent` payload and the `task_ledger` custom record — never the content of the persisted assistant message record.

Possible directions (author's choice):

- Apply the strip **before** `MessageEndEvent` is emitted for a terminal message — e.g. in gate mode, parse-and-strip each assistant text block at finalize time in `_finishStreamed`, stashing the parsed ledger for the end-of-run event (mid-run blocks rarely carry a ledger, and the contract only sanctions one in the final answer anyway).
- Or defer persistence of the final assistant record until the fold has run (the session repo is append-only, but the CLI already has record-pruning machinery from the checkpoint/rewind path that could rewrite the tail).
- Whichever route: add a test that reads the persisted session JSONL and asserts the last assistant record contains no `task-ledger`, so this can't regress.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: ticket requirement #1 asked for 2-3 concrete negative examples — the added clause is abstract**

Ticket gh-1516 requirement 1: *"Include 2-3 negative examples in the prompt (a 'why did you…' question, a 'what does X do' question) — weak models follow examples better than abstract rules."* (The owner diagnosed this on a weak model that took the imperative prompt literally.)

The added trivial-turn clause is a single abstract rule with one generic parenthetical ("a pure question answered from what you already know"). There are no worked negative examples, so the exact failure mode the ticket describes — gpt-5-mini running the checklist ritual around a plain chat answer — is still only guarded by wording weak models demonstrably over-follow.

Since the gate now only fires headlessly, this clause is the entire defense for trivial questions in `fa -p` sessions. Please add the requested concrete examples, e.g.:

> The contract does NOT apply to turns like: "почему ты баш команды вызываешь?" (a "why did you…" question — answer directly, no checklist) or "what does the `read` selector `:N` do?" (a "what does X do" question — explain, no verification commands). These turns produced no state; the checklist and ledger are noise for them.

💡 **SUGGESTION: `stripTaskLedger` rewrites the whole answer's whitespace, not just the removal site**

The doc comment says "collapse them and trim the edges the ledger vacated", but the implementation collapses **every** blank-line run in the answer to a single blank and trims leading blanks of the whole text (`collapsed.join('\n').trimRight()` plus the leading-blank loop). An answer that intentionally used double blank lines between sections, or leading blank lines, comes out reformatted even though only the ledger lines were removed.

Low impact (final answers rarely carry meaningful multi-blank formatting, and the fenced/unfenced shapes are at the tail), but the visible answer is user-facing text — consider limiting the collapse to the span's immediate neighborhood: remove `[startLine, endLine]`, then collapse at most the blank runs that touch the vacated range, leaving the rest of the answer byte-identical.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

🚨 **BLOCKING: the strip runs after the message was already persisted and rendered — the transcript still shows the ledger**

The fold at `_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites only the in-memory `newMessages` / `currentContext.messages` and the `AgentEndEvent` payload. By the time it runs, two consumers have already seen the unstripped ledger:

1. **Live render** — the CLI streams answer deltas via `_onTextDelta` (`approval_commands.dart:1292`) and prints the buffered answer in `_flushAssistantStreamAtEnd` on `MessageEndEvent`. The fold cannot un-print text that already reached stdout.
2. **Session persistence** — `_persistIncremental` (`agent_cli_persist.dart:12`) appends every `MessageEndEvent` message to the session JSONL immediately. The final assistant record on disk therefore still contains the full `task-ledger` block.

Verified empirically (scripted headless run, `read` tool call + fenced ledger answer): the persisted assistant record in the session JSONL still contains the complete unstripped ledger. Consequences:

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.
- `fa trajectory`, the attach view, and the bench `agent-logs/fah-sessions` sync all render the ledger from the JSONL assistant record.

This contradicts the PR description ("whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it") and ticket requirement 2 ("parse, persist as the hidden record, never leave it in the transcript"). The existing tests don't catch it because they assert only the `AgentEndEvent` payload and the `task_ledger` custom record — never the content of the persisted assistant message record.

Possible directions (author's choice):

- Apply the strip **before** `MessageEndEvent` is emitted for a terminal message — e.g. in gate mode, parse-and-strip each assistant text block at finalize time in `_finishStreamed`, stashing the parsed ledger for the end-of-run event (mid-run blocks rarely carry a ledger, and the contract only sanctions one in the final answer anyway).
- Or defer persistence of the final assistant record until the fold has run (the session repo is append-only, but the CLI already has record-pruning machinery from the checkpoint/rewind path that could rewrite the tail).
- Whichever route: add a test that reads the persisted session JSONL and asserts the last assistant record contains no `task-ledger`, so this can't regress.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

1. **Live render** — the CLI streams answer deltas via `_onTextDelta` (`approval_commands.dart:1292`) and prints the buffered answer in `_flushAssistantStreamAtEnd` on `MessageEndEvent`. The fold cannot un-print text that already reached stdout.
2. **Session persistence** — `_persistIncremental` (`agent_cli_persist.dart:12`) appends every `MessageEndEvent` message to the session JSONL immediately. The final assistant record on disk therefore still contains the full `task-ledger` block.

Verified empirically (scripted headless run, `read` tool call + fenced ledger answer): the persisted assistant record in the session JSONL still contains the complete unstripped ledger. Consequences:

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.
- `fa trajectory`, the attach view, and the bench `agent-logs/fah-sessions` sync all render the ledger from the JSONL assistant record.

This contradicts the PR description ("whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it") and ticket requirement 2 ("parse, persist as the hidden record, never leave it in the transcript"). The existing tests don't catch it because they assert only the `AgentEndEvent` payload and the `task_ledger` custom record — never the content of the persisted assistant message record.

Possible directions (author's choice):

- Apply the strip **before** `MessageEndEvent` is emitted for a terminal message — e.g. in gate mode, parse-and-strip each assistant text block at finalize time in `_finishStreamed`, stashing the parsed ledger for the end-of-run event (mid-run blocks rarely carry a ledger, and the contract only sanctions one in the final answer anyway).
- Or defer persistence of the final assistant record until the fold has run (the session repo is append-only, but the CLI already has record-pruning machinery from the checkpoint/rewind path that could rewrite the tail).
- Whichever route: add a test that reads the persisted session JSONL and asserts the last assistant record contains no `task-ledger`, so this can't regress.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The attendance re-keying (`headlessRun` instead of `approvalMode`) is the right fix for the interactive-autopilot regression, and the tolerant unfenced-ledger parsing is well tested — but the ledger strip lands too late: the final message is streamed to stdout and persisted to the session JSONL before the fold runs, so the persisted transcript (resume, `fa trajectory`, bench log sync) still shows the ledger the ticket says must never render. One ticket-requirement gap (no concrete negative examples in the prompt) and four smaller polish items below.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 The fold runs after `MessageEndEvent` — persistence and live render already happened (comment1)
- ⚠️ Ticket req #1 asked for 2-3 concrete negative examples in the prompt; only an abstract rule was added (comment2)

**Next Steps**:
1. Make the strip effective for the persisted/streamed transcript, not just the in-memory/event payload (see comment1 for options)
2. Add the concrete "why did you…" / "what does X do…" negative examples to `finalize_gate.md`

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

🚨 **BLOCKING: the strip runs after the message was already persisted and rendered — the transcript still shows the ledger**

The fold at `_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites only the in-memory `newMessages` / `currentContext.messages` and the `AgentEndEvent` payload. By the time it runs, two consumers have already seen the unstripped ledger:

1. **Live render** — the CLI streams answer deltas via `_onTextDelta` (`approval_commands.dart:1292`) and prints the buffered answer in `_flushAssistantStreamAtEnd` on `MessageEndEvent`. The fold cannot un-print text that already reached stdout.
2. **Session persistence** — `_persistIncremental` (`agent_cli_persist.dart:12`) appends every `MessageEndEvent` message to the session JSONL immediately. The final assistant record on disk therefore still contains the full `task-ledger` block.

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

🚨 **BLOCKING: the strip runs after the message was already persisted and rendered — the transcript still shows the ledger**

The fold at `_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites only the in-memory `newMessages` / `currentContext.messages` and the `AgentEndEvent` payload. By the time it runs, two consumers have already seen the unstripped ledger:

1. **Live render** — the CLI streams answer deltas via `_onTextDelta` (`approval_commands.dart:1292`) and prints the buffered answer in `_flushAssistantStreamAtEnd` on `MessageEndEvent`. The fold cannot un-print text that already reached stdout.
2. **Session persistence** — `_persistIncremental` (`agent_cli_persist.dart:12`) appends every `MessageEndEvent` message to the session JSONL immediately. The final assistant record on disk therefore still contains the full `task-ledger` block.

Verified empirically (scripted headless run, `read` tool call + fenced ledger answer): the persisted assistant record in the session JSONL still contains the complete unstripped ledger. Consequences:

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.
- `fa trajectory`, the attach view, and the bench `agent-logs/fah-sessions` sync all render the ledger from the JSONL assistant record.

This contradicts the PR description ("whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it") and ticket requirement 2 ("parse, persist as the hidden record, never leave it in the transcript"). The existing tests don't catch it because they assert only the `AgentEndEvent` payload and the `task_ledger` custom record — never the content of the persisted assistant message record.

Possible directions (author's choice):

- Apply the strip **before** `MessageEndEvent` is emitted for a terminal message — e.g. in gate mode, parse-and-strip each assistant text block at finalize time in `_finishStreamed`, stashing the parsed ledger for the end-of-run event (mid-run blocks rarely carry a ledger, and the contract only sanctions one in the final answer anyway).
- Or defer persistence of the final assistant record until the fold has run (the session repo is append-only, but the CLI already has record-pruning machinery from the checkpoint/rewind path that could rewrite the tail).
- Whichever route: add a test that reads the persisted session JSONL and asserts the last assistant record contains no `task-ledger`, so this can't regress.

The interceptor has already stripped the ledger from the persisted transcript, but no `TaskLedgerEvent` fires — the self-check data is gone entirely. Under gh-1412, those runs kept the ledger in the transcript (no event either, since the old gate code was also after the loop... wait no!).

So old behavior on error-stop: no TaskLedgerEvent, ledger remained visible in the transcript. New behavior: no TaskLedgerEvent, ledger REMOVED from the transcript and lost.

So the delta: previously recoverable from transcript, now silently discarded. And arguably the gate's purpose (near-miss telemetry on unattended runs) is most valuable exactly for failed/aborted runs. This is a real regression worth flagging. Severity: IMPORTANT (arguably blocking? The ticket AC: "whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it" — rewriting happens, but the record persistence is skipped on error paths. The PR description claims gate fires for produced-state runs; an aborted produced-state run now loses its ledger). I'd say IMPORTANT — the fix is small: run the fold before the early return too, or emit the fold in _terminalRunMessages. But careful — gh-1412's rule: "run must END on the answer". An error/aborted message IS an AssistantMessage ending the run. The old `_finalTaskLedger` would have parsed it if reached. So firing on error stop is defensible.

Actually wait — there's another subtlety with aborted runs: `_abortedTurn` → emits MessageEndEvent(message) with stopReason.aborted. The interceptor strips if a ledger parses. Then `_terminalRunMessages` → early return. Ledger lost. Yes.

2. **Raw TUI live rendering still shows ledger in headless?** The gate is headless-only; in `fa -p` there's no interactive TUI streaming answers to a human in the same way; deltas go to stdout though — `fa -p` output is printed. The rework reply acknowledged this: "raw-mode live deltas that already reached stdout cannot be un-printed, but the gate is headless-only and buffered/headless end-of-message rendering reads the event payload". For `fa -p`, output is consumed by bench harness; bench log sync renders from JSONL. Acceptable; documented.

3. **Stash growth**: one entry per stripped message; a run with thousands of messages each with a ledger — memory O(n). Fine, per-run.

4. **Multiple text blocks per message**: `_stripAssistantLedger` strips only the LAST text block carrying a ledger (one resolve per message). If an earlier block also had a ledger, it stays rendered. Old code: also only last block's first ledger (returned after first block from reversed). Actually old `_finalTaskLedger` iterated blocks reversed and returned on FIRST parseable block — same "one block". But old behavior kept other blocks' ledgers in transcript too (nothing stripped). New: strips one block per message; a second ledger block in the same message remains. Edge case — models put one ledger. SUGGESTION maybe not even worth it.

5. **The interceptor and `_onAssistantMessageEnd` flush**: comment claims flush reads event payload — verified by test asserting MessageEndEvent payload. OK.

6. **`_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites `newMessages[last]` even when `producedState` is false** — yes: strip is applied to transcript regardless, event only when produced state. Matches trivial-turn semantics: ledger stripped but no record. OK.

Includes all turns of the run. OK.

Line 2065 `_finishWithoutStream` — returns `message`, same instance. Line 1973 `_finishStreamed`. Hmm, wait — actually if `_stampSessionUniqueToolCallIds` returns a copy, that happens BEFORE MessageEndEvent emission in `_finishStreamed`, so event carries the final instance. OK.

But there's one more: `TurnEndEvent(message: message...)` — irrelevant.

What about `prepareNextTurn` turnUpdate replacing context — the context copy in fold is `currentContext.messages` at loop end; the fold patches `contextMessages` via `lastIndexWhere(identical)`. If the context was REPLACED by a turn update with a copied message list (not identical instances), `at` = -1 → context copy not patched, but newMessages still patched. Residual ledger in the replaced context — but that context is discarded after the run anyway (currentContext is local to _runAgentLoop). Actually wait — is currentContext.messages the same list object as the caller's context? `_runAgentLoop` receives a context; `currentContext = context` initially; messages added in place. The fold patches it so "the returned run matches the persisted session". If a turn update swapped in a new context object whose messages list contains copies, the patch silently misses. Edge case, low severity. The `at >= 0` guard means no crash.

Actually in `_finishStreamed`, `addedPartial` — if the partial was already in context, it REPLACES it. So the degenerate message was persisted to JSONL (its MessageEndEvent fired → `_persistIncremental` appended it), then replaced in memory. Persisted JSONL now contains BOTH the degenerate stripped message AND the retried message? That's pre-existing persistence behavior (append-only), not changed by this PR. Fine.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix

The fold at `_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites only the in-memory `newMessages` / `currentContext.messages` and the `AgentEndEvent` payload. By the time it runs, two consumers have already seen the unstripped ledger:

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

_Previous review discussions for PR #1523._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 9

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The attendance re-keying (`headlessRun` instead of `approvalMode`) is the right fix for the interactive-autopilot regression, and the tolerant unfenced-ledger parsing is well tested — but the ledger strip lands too late: the final message is streamed to stdout and persisted to the session JSONL before the fold runs, so the persisted transcript (resume, `fa trajectory`, bench log sync) still shows the ledger the ticket says must never render. One ticket-requirement gap (no concrete negative examples in the prompt) and four smaller polish items below.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 The fold runs after `MessageEndEvent` — persistence and live render already happened (comment1)
- ⚠️ Ticket req #1 asked for 2-3 concrete negative examples in the prompt; only an abstract rule was added (comment2)

**Next Steps**:
1. Make the strip effective for the persisted/streamed transcript, not just the in-memory/event payload (see comment1 for options)
2. Add the concrete "why did you…" / "what does X do…" negative examples to `finalize_gate.md`
3. Address the suggestion-level items as time permits — none block merge

---

### Thread 10

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

### Thread 12

<!-- dmtools:rework-consume {"path":"cross-anchor","head":"92902c1b795120b41e8bd14d88d78296b9bff529","at":"2026-10-11T00:03:41.624Z"} -->

---


## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

🚨 **BLOCKING: the strip runs after the message was already persisted and rendered — the transcript still shows the ledger**

The fold at `_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites only the in-memory `newMessages` / `currentContext.messages` and the `AgentEndEvent` payload. By the time it runs, two consumers have already seen the unstripped ledger:

1. **Live render** — the CLI streams answer deltas via `_onTextDelta` (`approval_commands.dart:1292`) and prints the buffered answer in `_flushAssistantStreamAtEnd` on `MessageEndEvent`. The fold cannot un-print text that already reached stdout.
2. **Session persistence** — `_persistIncremental` (`agent_cli_persist.dart:12`) appends every `MessageEndEvent` message to the session JSONL immediately. The final assistant record on disk therefore still contains the full `task-ledger` block.

Verified empirically (scripted headless run, `read` tool call + fenced ledger answer): the persisted assistant record in the session JSONL still contains the complete unstripped ledger. Consequences:

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.
- `fa trajectory`, the attach view, and the bench `agent-logs/fah-sessions` sync all render the ledger from the JSONL assistant record.

This contradicts the PR description ("whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it") and ticket requirement 2 ("parse, persist as the hidden record, never leave it in the transcript"). The existing tests don't catch it because they assert only the `AgentEndEvent` payload and the `task_ledger` custom record — never the content of the persisted assistant message record.

Possible directions (author's choice):

- Apply the strip **before** `MessageEndEvent` is emitted for a terminal message — e.g. in gate mode, parse-and-strip each assistant text block at finalize time in `_finishStreamed`, stashing the parsed ledger for the end-of-run event (mid-run blocks rarely carry a ledger, and the contract only sanctions one in the final answer anyway).
- Or defer persistence of the final assistant record until the fold has run (the session repo is append-only, but the CLI already has record-pruning machinery from the checkpoint/rewind path that could rewrite the tail).
- Whichever route: add a test that reads the persisted session JSONL and asserts the last assistant record contains no `task-ledger`, so this can't regress.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: ticket requirement #1 asked for 2-3 concrete negative examples — the added clause is abstract**

Ticket gh-1516 requirement 1: *"Include 2-3 negative examples in the prompt (a 'why did you…' question, a 'what does X do' question) — weak models follow examples better than abstract rules."* (The owner diagnosed this on a weak model that took the imperative prompt literally.)

The added trivial-turn clause is a single abstract rule with one generic parenthetical ("a pure question answered from what you already know"). # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

1. **Live render** — the CLI streams answer deltas via `_onTextDelta` (`approval_commands.dart:1292`) and prints the buffered answer in `_flushAssistantStreamAtEnd` on `MessageEndEvent`. The fold cannot un-print text that already reached stdout.
2. **Session persistence** — `_persistIncremental` (`agent_cli_persist.dart:12`) appends every `MessageEndEvent` message to the session JSONL immediately. The final assistant record on disk therefore still contains the full `task-ledger` block.

Verified empirically (scripted headless run, `read` tool call + fenced ledger answer): the persisted assistant record in the session JSONL still contains the complete unstripped ledger. Consequences:

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.
- `fa trajectory`, the attach view, and the bench `agent-logs/fah-sessions` sync all render the ledger from the JSONL assistant record.

This contradicts the PR description ("whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it") and ticket requirement 2 ("parse, persist as the hidden record, never leave it in the transcript"). The existing tests don't catch it because they assert only the `AgentEndEvent` payload and the `task_ledger` custom record — never the content of the persisted assistant message record.

Possible directions (author's choice):

- Apply the strip **before** `MessageEndEvent` is emitted for a terminal message — e.g. in gate mode, parse-and-strip each assistant text block at finalize time in `_finishStreamed`, stashing the parsed ledger for the end-of-run event (mid-run blocks rarely carry a ledger, and the contract only sanctions one in the final answer anyway).
- Or defer persistence of the final assistant record until the fold has run (the session repo is append-only, but the CLI already has record-pruning machinery from the checkpoint/rewind path that could rewrite the tail).
- Whichever route: add a test that reads the persisted session JSONL and asserts the last assistant record contains no `task-ledger`, so this can't regress.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

🚨 **BLOCKING: the strip runs after the message was already persisted and rendered — the transcript still shows the ledger**

The fold at `_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites only the in-memory `newMessages` / `currentContext.messages` and the `AgentEndEvent` payload. By the time it runs, two consumers have already seen the unstripped ledger:

1. **Live render** — the CLI streams answer deltas via `_onTextDelta` (`approval_commands.dart:1292`) and prints the buffered answer in `_flushAssistantStreamAtEnd` on `MessageEndEvent`. The fold cannot un-print text that already reached stdout.
2. **Session persistence** — `_persistIncremental` (`agent_cli_persist.dart:12`) appends every `MessageEndEvent` message to the session JSONL immediately. The final assistant record on disk therefore still contains the full `task-ledger` block.

Verified empirically (scripted headless run, `read` tool call + fenced ledger answer): the persisted assistant record in the session JSONL still contains the complete unstripped ledger. Consequences:

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.
- `fa trajectory`, the attach view, and the bench `agent-logs/fah-sessions` sync all render the ledger from the JSONL assistant record.

This contradicts the PR description ("whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it") and ticket requirement 2 ("parse, persist as the hidden record, never leave it in the transcript"). The existing tests don't catch it because they assert only the `AgentEndEvent` payload and the `task_ledger` custom record — never the content of the persisted assistant message record.

Possible directions (author's choice):

- Apply the strip **before** `MessageEndEvent` is emitted for a terminal message — e.g. in gate mode, parse-and-strip each assistant text block at finalize time in `_finishStreamed`, stashing the parsed ledger for the end-of-run event (mid-run blocks rarely carry a ledger, and the contract only sanctions one in the final answer anyway).
- Or defer persistence of the final assistant record until the fold has run (the session repo is append-only, but the CLI already has record-pruning machinery from the checkpoint/rewind path that could rewrite the tail).
- Whichever route: add a test that reads the persisted session JSONL and asserts the last assistant record contains no `task-ledger`, so this can't regress.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: ticket requirement #1 asked for 2-3 concrete negative examples — the added clause is abstract**

Ticket gh-1516 requirement 1: *"Include 2-3 negative examples in the prompt (a 'why did you…' question, a 'what does X do' question) — weak models follow examples better than abstract rules."* (The owner diagnosed this on a weak model that took the imperative prompt literally.)

The added trivial-turn clause is a single abstract rule with one generic parenthetical ("a pure question answered from what you already know"). There are no worked negative examples, so the exact failure mode the ticket describes — gpt-5-mini running the checklist ritual around a plain chat answer — is still only guarded by wording weak models demonstrably over-follow.

Since the gate now only fires headlessly, this clause is the entire defense for trivial questions in `fa -p` sessions. Please add the requested concrete examples, e.g.:

> The contract does NOT apply to turns like: "почему ты баш команды вызываешь?" (a "why did you…" question — answer directly, no checklist) or "what does the `read` selector `:N` do?" (a "what does X do" question — explain, no verification commands). These turns produced no state; the checklist and ledger are noise for them.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: `stripTaskLedger` rewrites the whole answer's whitespace, not just the removal site**

The doc comment says "collapse them and trim the edges the ledger vacated", but the implementation collapses **every** blank-line run in the answer to a single blank and trims leading blanks of the whole text (`collapsed.join('\n').trimRight()` plus the leading-blank loop). An answer that intentionally used double blank lines between sections, or leading blank lines, comes out reformatted even though only the ledger lines were removed.

Low impact (final answers rarely carry meaningful multi-blank formatting, and the fenced/unfenced shapes are at the tail), but the visible answer is user-facing text — consider limiting the collapse to the span's immediate neighborhood: remove `[startLine, endLine]`, then collapse at most the blank runs that touch the vacated range, leaving the rest of the answer byte-identical.

For a pathological answer with many candidate spans this is quadratic-ish and purely redundant.

Consider exposing one helper that returns the winning `_LedgerSpan` (and its parsed `TaskLedger`) once, and deriving both the event payload and the stripped text from it — e.g. `stripTaskLedger` accepting an optional pre-resolved span. Good, the previous review round's threads were all addressed. Now I need to do my own exhaustive review of the current head (6bff6972b). Key areas to scrutinize:

1. The interceptor approach: `_finalizeGateStrippingSink` wraps `emit` per-run. Check:
   - It's only installed if `config.finalizeGate` at loop start — but gateOn reads live config. If config flips ON mid-run, the interceptor isn't installed but `_emitFinalizeGateFold` uses `currentConfig.finalizeGate` — check the call site: `if (currentConfig.finalizeGate) { await _emitFinalizeGateFold(...); }` with the stash possibly empty. If gate flipped on mid-run, stash is empty → fold==null → return. OK consistent.
   - If gate flips OFF mid-run: interceptor installed but gateOn() returns false → passthrough. And the end-of-run fold guarded by currentConfig.finalizeGate → skipped. But messages stripped earlier in the run stay stripped — transcript differs from... fine, minor.
   - Unbounded stash growth: stash accumulates every stripped message during a run. For very long runs with many messages containing ledger-ish content — each message is stripped once. Memory is fine-ish, but the stash never gets cleared; it's per-run so it's freed after run. OK.
   - The stash match uses `identical(entry.original, terminal)`. `newMessages.last` — is the message object the same instance that flowed through the MessageEndEvent? Need to verify. If MessageEndEvent carries a different instance (e.g., copied), `identical` fails and the gate never fires! This is a potential BLOCKING bug. Let me check how MessageEndEvent is emitted in agent_loop.dart — does the loop emit the same `AssistantMessage` instance that ends up in newMessages?

2. `_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites `newMessages[newMessages.length-1] = matched.stripped` and patches contextMessages. But AgentEndEvent gets `List.unmodifiable(newMessages)` after rewrite — good.

3. What about `MessageEndEvent` for the terminal message: strip happens at event time, so hosts persist stripped. Then fold emits TaskLedgerEvent AFTER AgentEnd? No — order: fold runs before `emit(AgentEndEvent(...))`. Fine.

4. `_stripAssistantLedger` strips ONE text block (returns after first block with a ledger, last block first). But a message could have multiple text blocks each with a ledger — the old `_finalTaskLedger` also returned the first ledger found from the last block. Consistent-ish. But note: the interceptor strips only one block per message. If an earlier text block also has a ledger, it stays in the transcript. Old behavior only parsed the last block too. Minor.

Wait — actually there's a subtle issue: `_stripAssistantLedger` scans blocks from last to first and returns the stripped message after replacing ONE block. The stash gets one entry per stripped message. Fine.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1523
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1523
- **Title**: gh-1516 [BUG] FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions: approvalMode=autopilot turns on unattended verification ritual + visible task-ledger garbage (gh-1412 regression)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1516` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 13
- **Additions**: +788
- **Deletions**: -133
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T21:57:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T00:11:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1516
## gh-1516: FinalizeGate leaks into interactive sessions

### Root Cause
The FinalizeGate was keyed on the approval **mode** (`approvalMode == unattended`) as a proxy for attendance. Autopilot in an interactive TUI is attended, yet `agent_cli.dart` + `agent_cli_prompt.dart` turned the full gh-1412 verification contract on — the model ran the checklist ritual on every answer, and the unfenced `task-ledger` near-miss shape was neither parsed nor stripped, so it rendered as transcript garbage.

### Fix
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_prompt.dart`: gate + contract now key on `config.headlessRun` (attendance: `fa -p`/bench) — interactive sessions stay gate-free under **every** approval mode.
- `prompts/cli/finalize_gate.md` (+ regenerated `prompts.g.dart`): trivial-turn clause — pure Q&A (no produced state) answers directly, no checklist/ledger.
- `lib/src/agent/finalize_gate.dart`: tolerant `parseTaskLedger` (unfenced `task-ledger` heading + bullets) and new `stripTaskLedger` (fenced or unfenced).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`: `_foldTaskLedger` — no tool calls in the run ⇒ gate does not fire (no `TaskLedgerEvent`); whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_prompt_test.dart` — interactive×autopilot has NO contract (RED before fix); headless×any mode carries it.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_test.dart` — tolerant-strip unit tests: unfenced/bold-heading parse, fenced-wins, strip of both shapes, prose false-positives rejected.
- `test/agent/finalize_gate_loop_test.dart` — trivial turn: no event + over-eager ledger still stripped; produced-state turn: event + stripped message; unfenced near-miss fires the gate.
- `test/cli/finalize_gate_ledger_persist_test.dart`, `test/integration/fa_finalize_gate_test.dart` — updated to the attendance semantics (IT-1 headless keeps the full gh-1412 contract; IT-2 interactive autopilot persists no ledger).
- Full suite (`dart test` minus integration/llm/pty/browser-ext/io/perf tags): 10144 passed, 0 failed (one unrelated flake in a first run, green on two reruns); finalize-gate ITs pass with `--tags integration`.

### Notes
- Bench behavior unchanged: bench runs are `fa -p` → `headlessRun` true → full contract.
- `fa wire-serve` (not a `-p` run) keeps the gate off regardless of approval mode; flag in review if wire runs should count as unattended.
- Skipped the optional `agent.finalizeGate: on|off|auto` config knob — default `auto` (headless-only) is the whole fix; add the knob only if a concrete need appears.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

🚨 **BLOCKING: the strip runs after the message was already persisted and rendered — the transcript still shows the ledger**

The fold at `_emitFinalizeGateFold` rewrites only the in-memory `newMessages` / `currentContext.messages` and the `AgentEndEvent` payload. By the time it runs, two consumers have already seen the unstripped ledger:

1. **Live render** — the CLI streams answer deltas via `_onTextDelta` (`approval_commands.dart:1292`) and prints the buffered answer in `_flushAssistantStreamAtEnd` on `MessageEndEvent`. The fold cannot un-print text that already reached stdout.
2. **Session persistence** — `_persistIncremental` (`agent_cli_persist.dart:12`) appends every `MessageEndEvent` message to the session JSONL immediately. The final assistant record on disk therefore still contains the full `task-ledger` block.

Verified empirically (scripted headless run, `read` tool call + fenced ledger answer): the persisted assistant record in the session JSONL still contains the complete unstripped ledger. Consequences:

- **Resume** replays the ledger into the model's context — the "transcript never shows it" contract is broken exactly where it matters most for unattended runs.
- `fa trajectory`, the attach view, and the bench `agent-logs/fah-sessions` sync all render the ledger from the JSONL assistant record.

This contradicts the PR description ("whenever a ledger parses, the final answer is rewritten so the transcript never shows it") and ticket requirement 2 ("parse, persist as the hidden record, never leave it in the transcript"). The existing tests don't catch it because they assert only the `AgentEndEvent` payload and the `task_ledger` custom record — never the content of the persisted assistant message record.

Possible directions (author's choice):

- Apply the strip **before** `MessageEndEvent` is emitted for a terminal message — e.g. in gate mode, parse-and-strip each assistant text block at finalize time in `_finishStreamed`, stashing the parsed ledger for the end-of-run event (mid-run blocks rarely carry a ledger, and the contract only sanctions one in the final answer anyway).
- Or defer persistence of the final assistant record until the fold has run (the session repo is append-only, but the CLI already has record-pruning machinery from the checkpoint/rewind path that could rewrite the tail).
- Whichever route: add a test that reads the persisted session JSONL and asserts the last assistant record contains no `task-ledger`, so this can't regress.

---
